scope: Phase 1.1 additive monorepo skeleton and migration-safety foundation

criteria.description: The Phase 1.1 scope is explicit, bounded to root skeleton/migration safety, and excludes runtime extraction.
criteria.limitations: This is an implementation-readiness decision; it does not approve Phase 1.2 or any production operation.

criteria.description: Current boundaries, child repository preservation rules, ownership, dependencies, and migration contracts are identified.
criteria.limitations: Cross-service equivalence, live providers, deployment, and persistence migration remain future work.

criteria.description: The root implementation has deterministic validation, recovery/rollback controls, and an evidence plan proportional to the cross-system change surface.
criteria.limitations: Docker-backed compose behavior cannot be observed locally because Docker is unavailable; guarded commands must remain NOT_READY.

authority.scope: Phase 1.1 additive monorepo skeleton and migration-safety foundation
authority.decision: Proceed without runtime extraction, deployment, or external mutation.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate if the scope expands to runtime, persistence, credentials, deployment, or irreversible history changes.

next_action: Implement and validate only the additive Phase 1.1 root skeleton under the frozen ownership boundaries.
revalidation_triggers: Any runtime source, manifest, lockfile, Dockerfile, or child path is changed
The root skeleton needs an executable application or compose service
The user requests Phase 1.2 contracts or a production/external operation
A new boundary, data, security, or authorization requirement is discovered
